sources.source: Sexual offences prevalence and victim characteristics, England and Wales
sources.verified_fact: The year-ending-March-2025 edition was released 4 November 2025 and combines Crime Survey for England and Wales and police-recorded evidence; the survey estimates use a half sample and police-recorded sexual offences are not a reliable trend measure.
sources.quality_effect: Adds sensitive victimisation context with half-sample and recording-practice guards; it is not parcel evidence or an individual-risk inference.

sources.source: Stalking: findings from the Crime Survey for England and Wales
sources.verified_fact: The year-ending-March-2025 edition was released 25 September 2025 and reports accredited survey estimates on stalking numbers, types and personal characteristics.
sources.quality_effect: Adds national survey context while preventing prevalence estimates or personal characteristics from being converted into local events, parcel probabilities or individual inference.

sources.source: Fraud and computer misuse in England and Wales: year ending March 2025
sources.verified_fact: The accredited release was published 26 March 2026 and corrected 10 April 2026 because Action Fraud figures had been described as fraud-and-computer-misuse offences rather than fraud offences only.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a corrected-version read guard and keeps CSEW and National Fraud Intelligence Bureau evidence separate from local crime or parcel safety scoring.

sources.source: Police powers and procedures: stop and search, arrests and mental health detentions, year ending March 2025
sources.verified_fact: Published 6 November 2025, the release covers 43 territorial forces and British Transport Police and records explicit limitations for outcome-category changes, partial force submissions and force-recording differences.
sources.quality_effect: Adds operational police-powers context with denominator and comparability guards; searches, arrests and detentions are not incident prevalence or parcel risk.

sources.verified_fact: Updated 29 June 2026, the release covers criminal-justice-system activity for January to December 2025, including out-of-court resolutions, prosecutions, convictions, remands and sentencing.
sources.quality_effect: Adds current justice-system pathway context while preventing disposals, prosecutions or sentencing volumes from being treated as crime prevalence, severity weights or parcel safety.

quality_guards: AREA_LEVEL_PROXY only; no parcel measurement claim.
Sexual-offence survey estimates use a half sample and police-recorded figures are not a reliable trend measure.
Stalking survey characteristics are not local events or individual inference.
Fraud evidence must use the corrected 10 April 2026 version.
Police-powers statistics have force-coverage and recording-comparability limits.
Criminal-justice disposals are not crime prevalence or severity weights.
No existing candidate score or stored parcel value was modified.
